Name: Manuel Antonio National Park
Brief Description: Costa Rica's most visited national park. World-class beaches, wildlife (monkeys, sloths), 350+ bird species. Closed Tuesdays. $18 entry.

Name: Marina Pez Vela Quepos
Brief Description: Modern marina with sportfishing, restaurants, shops. Sunset dining with harbor views.

Name: Damas Island Estuary
Brief Description: Mangrove ecosystem tours by kayak or boat. Crocodiles, monkeys, sloths, diverse birdlife.

Name: Dominical
Brief Description: Laid-back surf town on Costanera Sur. Good lunch stop, adventure tour hub, consistent waves.

Name: Nauyaca Waterfalls
Brief Description: Two impressive cascading waterfalls with swimming hole. Hiking or horseback access from Dominical.

Name: Marino Ballena National Park
Brief Description: Costa Rica's first marine park. Famous whale-tail sandbar visible at low tide. Whale watching Dec-Apr.

Name: Whale Tail (Punta Uvita)
Brief Description: Unique natural tombolo formation shaped like whale tail. Walk on sandbar at low tide only.

Name: Ballena Islands
Brief Description: Three offshore rock formations with coral reefs and nesting seabirds. Boat tours available.

Name: Ojochal
Brief Description: Small expat community known for excellent international restaurants. French, fusion cuisine.

Name: Terraba-Sierpe Wetlands
Brief Description: Costa Rica's largest wetland (24,730 ha). Mangrove channels with crocodiles, diverse birdlife.

Name: Finca 6 Stone Spheres UNESCO
Brief Description: UNESCO World Heritage Site. Pre-Columbian stone spheres up to 2.57m diameter. Museum and trails. $6 entry.

Name: Palmar Sur Stone Spheres Park
Brief Description: Additional stone spheres in park setting. Two large spheres famously saved by local students.

Name: Sierpe River Gateway
Brief Description: Departure point for Drake Bay and Corcovado. Mangrove river tours excellent for wildlife.

Name: Paso Real Junction
Brief Description: Key junction where route turns from Inter-American Highway toward San Vito highlands.

Name: Centro Cultural Dante Alighieri
Brief Description: Italian cultural center in San Vito documenting 1952 immigration history. Across from central park.

Name: San Vito Central Park
Brief Description: Heart of Costa Rica's Italian heritage town. Founded 1952 by Italian immigrants.

Name: Wilson Botanical Garden
Brief Description: World-class botanical garden, 2nd largest palm collection globally. 425+ bird species. OTS research station.

Name: Las Cruces Biological Station
Brief Description: Research facility with lodging. Part of La Amistad Biosphere Reserve. Excellent trails.

Name: Rio Sereno Border Crossing
Brief Description: Quieter Costa Rica-Panama border. Mountain crossing between San Vito and Volcan.

Name: Volcan Town Center
Brief Description: Charming Panama highland town nicknamed Little Switzerland. European settler heritage.

Name: Lagunas de Volcan
Brief Description: Natural lagoons with mountain views. Hiking, fishing, horseback riding on private land.

Name: Volcan Baru National Park
Brief Description: Panama's highest peak (3,474m). See both oceans on clear days. Cloud forests, quetzals.

Name: La Amistad International Park
Brief Description: UNESCO World Heritage Site spanning Costa Rica-Panama. Largest Central American protected area.

Name: Sendero Los Quetzales
Brief Description: Famous hiking trail around Volcan Baru. Prime quetzal habitat connecting Boquete to Cerro Punta.

Name: Cerro Punta
Brief Description: Highest inhabited village in Panama. Gateway to La Amistad and Volcan Baru trails.

Name: Finca Ceriana Nature Reserve
Brief Description: Private conservation area in highlands-lowlands transition zone. Wildlife viewing.
